amends.original_rule: A level passes iff mean F_true > 0, F_true > 0 for >= 75% of samples, and F_true > F_imposed for >= 75% of samples. The gate passes iff every pre-registered candidate passes both levels at the tuning seed 1017. Any failure blocks every v2 CAL job; no candidate is dropped or added after the gate.

amended_rule.level_conditions: the existing level-A verdict, unchanged: mean F_true > 0, F_true > 0 for >= 75% of samples, F_true > F_imposed for >= 75% of samples (thresholds of the pre-registration record)
amended_rule.candidate_rule: A frozen candidate is eligible for CAL iff it passes the level-A verdict at seed 1017. Ineligible candidates are excluded (not re-tuned, not replaced); eligible candidates keep the frozen order. The family gate passes iff a re-run of the CPU gate on the amended code reproduces the original run's verdicts and yields exactly the eligible orders below. Level B is reported as a diagnostic.

excluded_reason.8: bandwidth x0.5, ridge 1e-2: level-A F_true > 0 fraction 0.7281 (233/320) < 0.75

rationale_verbatim: the gate exists to stop degenerate energies like v1 (J < 0 everywhere, ranking at or below chance); v2 ranks the true pose above the imposed perturbation in 0.84–0.90 (A) / 0.72–0.82 (B); the per-sample J > 0 condition at level B is stricter than what a working kernel critic achieves here (V9 RFF kernel critic: J > 0 in 46% of CAL rows while registering)

theta0_outside_ridge.definition: (H + lambda D) theta = h_P with D = diag(0, 1, ..., 1) instead of the literal (H + lambda I) theta = h_P; kept
theta0_outside_ridge.reason: E_{(P+Q)/2}[g] = 1 holds exactly on FIT and the ridge shrinks the kernel part towards T = 0 instead of shrinking g towards 0 (T towards -1)
theta0_outside_ridge.fit_evidence: abc_c4 vs abc_c4_pen (4-fold FIT cross-fit): for ridge <= 1e-3 at all widths and for x0.5 at all ridges |delta mean J| <= 0.0002 and every fraction within 0.02; at x1/1e-2 the J > 0 fraction differs by 0.13 and at x2/1e-2 |delta mean J| = 0.0009 and truth > imposed differs by 0.11 (both outside the grid and far below the thresholds)

hardware.definition: every v2 GPU job (GPU gate, CAL, finals) on L40S only, excluding node51 and node60
hardware.reason: the per-family CAL budget unit is L40S allocated GPU-h and the other supplement CAL budgets were spent on L40S (comparability); run.py and validate.py check for NVIDIA L40S
hardware.deliberate_difference: differs on purpose from the user's 2026-10-19 09:31 UTC instruction to schedule pending GPU tasks on RTX6000PRO,L40S,H100, which concerned the seed-replication pool
